package.name: aav_spine_bridge
package.description: spine_bridge in Rust (rclrs): the same node as aav_spine's Python one, topic for topic. It turns ego's commands (/control/<target>/actuator_cmd, from the output mux, by its source parameter) and /safety/estop into CAN frames (firmware/can/aav.dbc, packed by the firmware's own spine-core) on /can/tx, and the spine's and the front wheel nodes' frames from /can/rx into /vehicle/odom, /vehicle/wheels, /vehicle/status and the rest. Its parameters are aav_spine's config/spine.yaml.
